brief: Precast concrete stave silo 30 ft tall and about 14 ft across, the pale grey staves gridded by dark close-set steel hoops, with no roof. Up the south side runs an enclosed unloading chute of curved corrugated metal sections, painted pale blue and badly rusted, beside a rusty silage fill pipe that hooks over the rim; two round steel hatch covers sit at the bottom of the door column. Mown grass all round, a small blue-grey shed and shade trees behind.
